title: Wild Ones
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After her mother dies, high-school girl Sachie Wakamura is taken in by her estranged grandfather, who turns out to head a yakuza gang. Rakuto, a popular classmate secretly in the gang, becomes her bodyguard, and the two fall for each other while she tries to keep a normal life and fit into her new family.
life_message: A good life means making a place in a new family through loyalty and kindness, while love grows slowly and honestly.
